title: T 形反馈网络的反相放大器
statement: 反相放大器的反馈支路是由 R_2、R_3、R_4 组成的 T 形网络。v_s = 0.2 V，R_1 = 10 kΩ，R_2 = R_3 = 50 kΩ，R_4 = 10 kΩ，运放为理想运放。
用结点电压法求结点 m 的电位 v_m、R_4 中的电流 i_4（参考方向见图）、输出电压 v_o。

questions.explain: i_4 = (v_m − 0)/R_4 = −1/10k = −0.1 mA，实际方向从地流向 m。

questions.ask: 若改用普通反相放大器（只有一个反馈电阻 R_f）得到相同的放大倍数，R_f 应为多少？
choiceExplain: 100 kΩ = R_2 + R_3，是把 T 形网络当成两个电阻串联，忽略了 R_4 对地分流；R_4 让 R_3 中的电流比 R_2 大得多。
110 kΩ = R_2 + R_3 + R_4，是把三个电阻全部串联；R_4 接在 m 与地之间，并不在反馈通路上串联。
50 kΩ 只取了直接接到 n 的 R_2（放大倍数 −5）；v_o 并不直接经 R_2 反馈，还要经过 R_3、R_4 组成的分压。
questions.explain: v_o/v_s = −7/0.2 = −35 = −R_f/R_1 → R_f = 350 kΩ。T 形网络用 50 kΩ、10 kΩ 这样较小的电阻就实现了很大的放大倍数：v_o/v_s = −(R_2 + R_3 + R_{2}R_{3}/R_4)/R_1。

hints: 反相端 n 是虚地，对 n 列结点方程（虚断）可直接求出 v_m。
再对 m 列结点方程，未知量只剩 v_o。注意运放输出端不能列 KCL（输出电流未知）。
solution: 设地为参考点。T 形网络把输出接回反相端，构成负反馈；同相端接地，由虚短 v_n = 0。运放输出端电流未知，所以只对 n、m 两个结点列方程。

en.title: Inverting amplifier with a T feedback network
statement: The feedback path of this inverting amplifier is a T network made of R_2, R_3 and R_4. v_s = 0.2 V, R_1 = 10 kΩ, R_2 = R_3 = 50 kΩ, R_4 = 10 kΩ; the op-amp is ideal.
Using nodal analysis, find the potential v_m of node m, the current i_4 in R_4 (reference as drawn) and the output voltage v_o.

questions.explain: Node n (virtual ground, virtual open): v_s/R_1 = (0 − v_m)/R_2 → 0.02 mA = −v_m/50k → v_m = −1 V.
i_4 = (v_m − 0)/R_4 = −1/10k = −0.1 mA; it actually flows from ground up into m.

questions.ask: An ordinary inverting amplifier (a single feedback resistor R_f) with the same gain would need R_f = ?
choiceExplain: 100 kΩ = R_2 + R_3 treats the T as two series resistors and ignores R_4's shunt to ground; R_4 makes R_3 carry much more current than R_2.
110 kΩ = R_2 + R_3 + R_4 puts all three in series; R_4 runs from m to ground and is not in series in the feedback path.
50 kΩ uses only R_2, the resistor on n (gain −5); v_o is not fed back through R_2 directly but through the R_3–R_4 divider first.
questions.explain: v_o/v_s = −7/0.2 = −35 = −R_f/R_1 → R_f = 350 kΩ. The T network reaches a large gain with modest resistors such as 50 kΩ and 10 kΩ: v_o/v_s = −(R_2 + R_3 + R_{2}R_{3}/R_4)/R_1.

hints: The inverting node n is a virtual ground; the node equation at n (virtual open) gives v_m directly.
Then write the node equation at m, where only v_o is unknown. Don't write KCL at the op-amp output — its output current is unknown.
solution: Take ground as reference. The T network connects the output back to the inverting input (negative feedback); the non-inverting input is grounded, so by the virtual short v_n = 0. The op-amp output current is unknown, so write node equations only at n and m.
